title: Affine intersections from an affine diagonal
statement: Let X be a scheme over a field k [def-weil-field] [def-pc-scheme] whose diagonal X \to X \times_{Spec(k)} X [def-pc-fibre-product] is affine. If U and V are affine open subschemes of X, then U \cap V is affine.
